CheckTitle: Ensure S3 buckets are not publicly accessible
StatusExtended: S3 bucket customer-exports is publicly accessible: a public-read ACL grants READ to AllUsers, so the data is exposed to the internet.
Risk: Anyone on the internet can list and download objects from this bucket.

Recommendation.Text: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the account and bucket level and remove the public-read ACL.

CheckTitle: Ensure S3 buckets have server-side encryption enabled
StatusExtended: Server-side encryption is not enabled for bucket app-logs, so objects are stored unencrypted at rest.

Recommendation.Text: Enable default SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS encryption on the bucket.

CheckTitle: Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled
StatusExtended: Server access logging is not configured for bucket app-logs.

Recommendation.Text: Enable server access logging and ship logs to a dedicated logging bucket.

CheckTitle: Ensure IAM policies do not grant full administrative privileges
StatusExtended: Customer managed policy devops-power grants Action: * on Resource: * (AdministratorAccess equivalent), which is overly permissive.

Recommendation.Text: Scope the policy to the specific actions and resources the role needs, following least privilege.

CheckTitle: Ensure MFA is enabled for IAM users with console access
StatusExtended: IAM user ci-deploy has console access enabled but no MFA device registered.

Recommendation.Text: Require and register an MFA device for every user with console access.

CheckTitle: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
StatusExtended: Access key for user legacy-svc has not been rotated in 412 days.

Recommendation.Text: Rotate the access key and delete unused keys.

CheckTitle: Ensure no root account access key exists
StatusExtended: The root account has an active access key, which should never exist.

Recommendation.Text: Delete the root account access key and use IAM roles/users instead.

CheckTitle: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22
StatusExtended: Security group sg-0a1b2c3d allows unrestricted ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22 (SSH), leaving it open to the world.

Recommendation.Text: Restrict SSH ingress to known admin CIDRs or move to SSM Session Manager.

CheckTitle: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 3389
StatusExtended: Security group sg-0b2c3d4e allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 3389 (RDP).

Recommendation.Text: Restrict RDP ingress to known admin CIDRs or use a bastion.

CheckTitle: Ensure EBS volumes are encrypted at rest
StatusExtended: EBS volume vol-0123456789abcdef0 is not encrypted, so data at rest is unencrypted.

Recommendation.Text: Enable EBS default encryption and re-create the volume from an encrypted snapshot.

CheckTitle: Ensure RDS instances are not publicly accessible
StatusExtended: RDS instance prod-db is publicly accessible from the internet and storage encryption is not enabled.

Recommendation.Text: Set PubliclyAccessible to false, place the instance in private subnets, and enable storage encryption.

CheckTitle: Ensure RDS automated backups are enabled
StatusExtended: Automated backups are disabled for RDS instance analytics-db (retention period 0).

Recommendation.Text: Set a backup retention period of at least 7 days.

CheckTitle: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
StatusExtended: CloudTrail is not enabled in all regions; management event logging disabled for 3 active regions.

Recommendation.Text: Create a multi-region trail capturing management and data events.

CheckTitle: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
StatusExtended: Log file integrity validation is not enabled for trail org-trail, so tampering cannot be detected.

Recommendation.Text: Enable log file validation on the trail.

CheckTitle: Ensure rotation is enabled for customer-managed KMS keys
StatusExtended: Automatic key rotation is not enabled for KMS key alias/app-data.

Recommendation.Text: Enable automatic annual key rotation for the customer-managed key.

CheckTitle: Ensure KMS key policies do not allow public access
StatusExtended: KMS key alias/exports has a key policy allowing kms:* for Principal * (public access), which is overly permissive.

Recommendation.Text: Scope the key policy to specific principals and remove the wildcard principal.

CheckTitle: Ensure S3 bucket versioning is enabled
StatusExtended: Versioning is enabled for bucket app-logs.
